verses.translation: Now the sons of Israel according to their number, heads of families, captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, and scribes ministering to the king, and for every affair of the king according to their divisions, for every ordinance of coming in and going out monthly, for all the months of the year, one division of them was twenty-four thousand.

translations.ron: Iată fiii lui Israel, după numărul lor, capii de familie, căpeteniile peste mii, peste sute şi cârmuitorii care, împărţiţi în cete, slujeau regelui la tot cuvântul, ducându-se şi venind în fiecare lună, în toate lunile anului. În fiecare ceată erau câte douăzeci şi patru de mii.

verses.translation: And over the first division of the first month was Isboaz the son of Zabdiel: in his division were twenty-four thousand.

translations.ron: Peste ceata întâi, pentru luna întâi, era căpetenia Iaşobeam, fiul lui Zabdiel; în ceata lui erau douăzeci şi patru de mii;

verses.translation: Of the sons of Tharez one was chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.

translations.ron: El era din fiii lui Fares, mai-mare peste toate căpeteniile de oştire în luna întâi.

verses.translation: And over the division of the second month was Dodia the son of Ecchoc, and over his division was Makelloth also chief: and in his division were twenty and four thousand, chief men of the host.

translations.ron: Peste ceata din luna a doua era Dodai Ahohitul; în ceata lui se afla şi căpetenia Miclot; şi în ceata lui erau douăzeci şi patru de mii.

verses.translation: The third for the third month was Banaias the son of Jodae the chief priest: and in his division were twenty and four thousand.

translations.ron: A treia mare căpetenie de oştire, pentru luna a treia, era Benaia, fiul lui Iehoiada preotul; şi în ceata lui erau douăzeci şi patru de mii.

verses.translation: This Banæas was more mighty than the thirty, and over the thirty: and Zabad his son was over his division.

translations.ron: Acest Benaia era unul dintre cei treizeci de viteji şi căpetenie peste ei; şi în ceata lui se afla Amizabad, fiul său.

verses.translation: The fourth for the fourth month was Asael the brother of Joab, and Zabadias his son, and his brethren: and in his division were twenty and four thousand.

translations.ron: A patra căpetenie, pentru luna a patra, era Asael, fratele lui Ioab, şi după el era Zebadia, fiul său; şi în ceata lui erau douăzeci şi patru de mii;

verses.translation: The fifth chief for the fifth month was Samaoth the Jezraite: and in his division were twenty and four thousand.

translations.ron: A cincea căpetenie, pentru luna a cincea, era Şamhut Izrahitul; şi în ceata lui erau douăzeci şi patru de mii.

verses.translation: The sixth for the sixth month was Hoduias the son of Ekkes the Thecoite: and in his division were twenty and four thousand.

translations.ron: A şasea căpetenie, pentru luna a şasea, era Ira, fiul lui Icheş Tecoanul; şi în ceata lui erau douăzeci şi patru de mii.

verses.translation: The seventh for the seventh month was Chelles of Phallus of the children of Ephraim: and in his division were twenty and four thousand.

translations.ron: A şaptea căpetenie, pentru luna a şaptea, era Heleţ Peloninul, din fiii lui Efraim; şi în ceata lui erau douăzeci şi patru de mii.

verses.translation: The eighth for the eighth month was Sobochai the Usathite, belonging to Zarai: and in his division were twenty and four thousand.

translations.ron: A opta căpetenie, pentru luna a opta, era Sibecai Huşatitul, din seminţia lui Zarah; şi în ceata lui erau douăzeci şi patru de mii.

verses.translation: The ninth for the ninth month was Abiezer of Anathoth, of the land of Benjamin: and in his division were twenty and four thousand.

translations.ron: A noua căpetenie, pentru luna a noua, era Abiezer Anatoteanul, din fiii lui Veniamin; şi în ceata lui erau douăzeci şi patru de mii.

verses.translation: The tenth for the tenth month was Meera the Netophathite, belonging to Zarai: and in his division were twenty and four thousand.

translations.ron: A zecea căpetenie, pentru luna a zecea, era Maherai din Netofat, din familia lui Zara; şi în ceata lui erau douăzeci şi patru de mii.

verses.translation: The eleventh for the eleventh month was Banaias of Pharathon, of the sons of Ephraim: and in his division were twenty and four thousand.

translations.ron: A unsprezecea căpetenie, pentru luna a unsprezecea, era Benaia din Piraton, din fiii lui Efraim; şi în ceata lui erau douăzeci şi patru de mii.

verses.translation: The twelfth for the twelfth month was Choldia the Netophathite, belonging to Gothoniel: and in his division were twenty and four thousand.

translations.ron: A douăsprezecea căpetenie, pentru luna a douăsprezecea, era Heldai din Netofat, din urmaşii lui Otniel; şi în ceata lui erau douăzeci şi patru de mii.

verses.translation: And over the tribes of Israel, the chief for Ruben was Eliezer the son of Zechri: for Symeon, Saphatias the son of Maacha:

translations.ron: Iar peste triburile lui Israel căpetenii înalte erau: la Rubeniţi, Eliezer, fiul lui Zicri; la Simeon, Şefatia, fiul lui Maaca;

verses.translation: for Levi, Asabias the son of Camuel: for Aaron, Sadoc:

translations.ron: La leviţi era Haşabia, fiul lui Chemuel; la Aaron era Ţadoc;

verses.translation: for Juda, Eliab of the brethren of David: for Issachar, Ambri the son of Michael:

translations.ron: La Iuda era Elihu, din fraţii lui David; la Isahar era Omri, fiul lui Micael;

verses.translation: for Zabulon, Samæas the son of Abdiu: for Nephthali, Jerimoth the son of Oziel:

translations.ron: La Zabulon era Işmaia, fiul lui Obadia; la Neftali era Ierimot, fiul lui Azriel;

verses.translation: for Ephraim, Ose the son of Ozia: for the half-tribe of Manasse, Joel the son of Phadæa:

translations.ron: La fiii lui Efraim era Hoseia, fiul lui Azazia; la jumătatea de trib a lui Manase era Ioil, fiul lui Pedaia;

verses.translation: for the half-tribe of Manasse in the land of Galaad, Jadai the son of Zadæas, for the sons of Benjamin, Jasiel the son of Abenner:

translations.ron: La jumătatea de trib al lui Manase din Galaad, era Ido, fiul lui Zaharia; la Veniamin era Iaasiel, fiul lui Abner;

verses.translation: for Dan, Azariel the son of Iroab: these are the chiefs of the tribes of Israel.

translations.ron: La Dan era Azareel, fiul lui Ieroham. Iată căpeteniile triburilor lui Israel.

verses.translation: But David took not their number from twenty years old and under: because the Lord said that he would multiply Israel as the stars of the heaven.

translations.ron: David n-a făcut numărătoarea acelora, care erau de la douăzeci de ani în jos, pentru că Domnul zisese că El va înmulţi pe Israel ca stelele cerului.

verses.translation: And Joab the son of Saruia began to number the people, and did not finish the work, for there was hereupon wrath on Israel; and the number was not recorded in the book of the chronicles of king David.

translations.ron: Ioab, fiul Ţeruiei, începuse să facă numărătoarea, dar nu o sfârşise. Şi pentru aceasta a venit mânia lui Dumnezeu asupra lui Israel şi numărătoarea aceea n-a intrat în cronica regelui David.

verses.translation: And over the king's treasures was Asmoth the son of Odiel; and over the treasures in the country, and in the towns, and in the villages, and in the towers, was Jonathan the son of Ozia.

translations.ron: Peste vistieriile regale era Azmavet, fiul lui Adiel, iar peste depozitele de provizii de la câmp, de prin cetăţi şi de prin sate şi turnuri era Ionatan, fiul lui Uzia.

verses.translation: And over the husbandmen who tilled the ground was Esdri the son of Chelub.

translations.ron: Peste cei ce se îndeletniceau cu lucrul câmpului, cu agricultura, era Ezri, fiul lui Chelub.

verses.translation: And over the fields was Semei of Rael; and over the treasures of wine in the fields was Zabdi the son of Sephni.

translations.ron: Peste vii era Şimei din Rama, iar peste depozitele de vin din vii era Zabdi, fiul lui Şifmi.

verses.translation: And over the oliveyards, and over the sycamores in the plain country was Ballanan the Gedorite; and over the stores of oil was Joas.

translations.ron: Peste livezile de măslini şi de smochini din câmpie era Baal-Hanan din Gheder, iar peste depozitele de untdelemn era Ioaş.

verses.translation: And over the oxen pasturing in Saron was Satrai the Saronite; and over the oxen in the valleys was Sophat the son of Adli.

translations.ron: Peste vitele mari care păşteau în Şaron era Şitrai Haşaroneanul; iar peste cele din văi, Şafat, fiul lui Adlai.

verses.translation: And over the camels was Abias the Ismaelite; and over the asses was Jadias of Merathon.

translations.ron: Peste cămile era Obil Ismaelitul; peste asini era Iehdia Meroneanul.

verses.translation: And over the sheep was Jaziz the Agarite. All these were superintendents of the substance of king David.

translations.ron: Peste oi şi capre era Iaziz Agariteanul. Toţi aceştia erau căpetenii peste averea regelui David.

verses.translation: And Jonathan, David's uncle by the father's side, was a counsellor, a wise man: and Jeel the son of Achami was with the king's sons.

translations.ron: Ionatan, unchiul lui David, era sfetnic, om înţelept şi scriitor; Iehiel, fiul lui Hacmoni, era pe lângă fiii regelui.

verses.translation: Achitophel was the king's counsellor: and Chusi the chief friend of the king.

translations.ron: Ahitofel era sfetnicul regelui; Huşai Architul era prietenul regelui.

verses.translation: And after this Achitophel Jodae the son of Banæas came next, and Abiathar: and Joab was the king's commander-in-chief.

translations.ron: Iar după Ahitofel a fost Iehoiada, fiul lui Benaia şi Abiatar, iar Ioab era căpetenia oştirii pe lângă rege.
